sources.fact: The fixed stack uses --space-4 for its bottom inset.
The arc uses the tone mix. The track at line 83 mixes 35% of that arc with --surface.
Dark mixes are 45% and 60%. Light mixes at line 460 are 95% and 85%.
Phoenix, Ocean and Emerald supplement the default Nebula accent. Status tones remain fixed.
Published reach includes the bottom inset. The current observer watches stack size, not position.
The current ring contract promises 2:1 against its track. The proposal raises this to 3:1.
The current text calls published reach the stack height. The implementation reports viewport bottom minus stack top.
Show lasting conditions is the current toast rule. No separate Toast guideline exists.

proposal.a: bottomOffset?: number | string. A number means pixels. A CSS length is accepted. Default: var(--space-4). The value is the total inset, not added clearance. Update published reach on prop changes and viewport resize. Consumers include safe-area clearance in this value when needed.
proposal.b: --ui-toast-bottom on the document root. Default: var(--space-4). The body portal cannot inherit a variable from an app subtree. CSS-only position changes need separate handling for published reach.
proposal.ring: Use var(--toast-action-ink) for the arc. Keep the full-circle track at 35% of the arc against var(--surface). No new colour token is needed.
proposal.recommendation: A keeps the setting in React and gives published reach a clear update signal. B needs a document-wide setting and more position tracking.
proposal.documentation: After approval, document the offset and 3:1 floor in Toast and the current toast guideline. Correct the height wording to reach.

limits: This is a static prototype. It does not change or certify the React provider.
Ring time is fixed at 75%. Timer pause, expiry, pile motion and forced colours are not newly verified.
The before side uses unchanged main CSS and matching toast markup. It is not a capture of the finance2 application.
Measurements compare opaque computed stroke colours. They do not measure antialiased edge pixels.
The source CSS is embedded for a single document in a sandbox with allow-scripts only.
assets: Lucide circle-check and x paths, as used by the kit.
Unmodified Google Fonts Latin subsets: IBM Plex Sans and Poppins. SIL Open Font License files are included.
